scope: Independent source/disassembly review of successful warmed resident hits. No build, workload, timing normalization or benchmark report generated by this review.
prediction_status: Static architectural-instruction path counts; not reported hardware measurements. TLS callee bodies, unchanged interface wrappers and probe bookkeeping are omitted from absolute totals. The deltas are expected to carry into matched full probes.
path_assumptions: valid page type and aligned in-range address
mapped resident identity remains stable; no eviction or writer race
CC_ACCESSED already set; CC_LOADING clear; read_status success

removed_division.sync: Alignment at async-load clockcache_get+0x3a (53a5a divq0x8(%rdi)) becomes page_size load/sub1/test at async-mask53a85–53a90.
removed_division.async: Alignment at async-load dispatcher9cd5d becomes loads/sub1/test at async-mask9cd54–9cd63.
removed_division.effect: Each successful get/unget executes two DIV instructions instead of three in main/original/async-load. This removes the geometry remainder division only, not all integer division from cache access.

retained_divisions.read_reference_acquisition: async-mask aa426 divq0x140(%rsi), indexing reference-count cache-line stripes
retained_divisions.miss_path: Allocator membership validation still contains division at9c8b4 in clockcache_get_from_disk_async.constprop.0.
retained_divisions.cold_diagnostics: clockcache_report_invalid_address retains modulo for diagnostic classification.

retained_checks.page_type: Range check remains before geometry in sync53a71/53a74 and async9cd43/9cd46.
retained_checks.alignment: Mask check runs before lookup indexing; invalid addresses still branch to cold diagnostics and error return.
retained_checks.lookup_bounds: Unsigned compare/jae remains before directory load: sync53ac5/53ac8; async9cd7e/9cd81.
retained_checks.mapping_and_reference: Unmapped sentinel branch, reference acquisition/status checks and exact entry-address comparison remain.
retained_checks.loading_and_error: CC_LOADING and read_status checks remain before returning a page; async waiter/retry handling is outside this immediate-hit path.
retained_checks.allocation_membership: Resident hits rely on mapping lifetime as before. A miss still validates allocator membership before reserving a cache entry or issuing I/O; moving that miss code out of the async dispatcher reduces its register-save burden.
retained_checks.config_contract: Release clockcache_config_init tests page_size!=0 and page_size&(page_size-1)==0 at51d6b–51d7b, before bsr51dce and division51de0.

frame_observations.sync: main/original reserve0x38 stack bytes; async-load/async-mask reserve0x48. All save six callee-saved registers. Masking does not remove this frame difference.
frame_observations.async_dispatcher: original saves four registers and reserves8 stack bytes; async-load/async-mask save one register and have no explicit stack reservation.

limitations: Static path counts do not predict exact cycle cost, frequency, cache misses, dependency stalls or throughput.
Retry/loading/error paths and statistics-enabled calls take different paths.
No correctness equivalence beyond inspected checks is claimed; separate existing contract and regression reviews cover those concerns.
